chunks: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The best of your women is the chaste, the ardently loving.'

key_terms.الْعَفِيفَةُ: al-'afifah — the chaste woman; one who guards her modesty and virtue rigorously in all contexts outside marriage
key_terms.الْغَلِمَةُ: al-ghalimaah — a woman of ardent desire; one who is passionate and loving toward her husband; classical scholars explain this as praising a wife's warmth and intimacy within the marital bond

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the best qualities of a Muslim woman?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq (AS) from the Prophet (SAWW), describes the ideal qualities of a woman in Islamic teaching: chastity ('iffah) in relation to all non-mahram men, combined with ardent loving desire (ghulmah) toward her husband. The pairing is deliberate — outward restraint and inward warmth together define a woman of exemplary character. In early Islamic society, this teaching corrected two extremes: immodesty in public conduct and coldness within marriage.
word_analysis: the ardently loving (sensual towards her husband)
